parts.title: The Assignment
parts.text: Agent Luna received the message at exactly midnight. She had to hurry, because time was **scarce** and none of it could be wasted. Her handler Liam confirmed that the mission **fund** had been approved, meaning she had everything she needed. She had **ample** training, and no one else in the agency could handle this kind of assignment.

parts.title: Into Danger
parts.text: The warehouse was in a **grimy** part of the city, with soot-streaked walls and broken streetlights. Luna moved with a calm **attitude** — cool and focused, betraying nothing. She preferred to use a small electronic **device** to scan for motion sensors before moving into any new space. A single wrong step could send a **ripple** of alerts through the entire security system. She needed to be **bold** but not reckless, even though her heartbeat was **rapid**.

parts.title: The Vault
parts.text: Inside, she found a safe hidden behind a painting. She used her scanner to crack its combination in seconds. The safe contained documents that could help **establish** the truth about a decades-old theft. A **hump** of folders was stacked neatly on the desk beside it. Luna would **prefer** to photograph everything rather than take originals, and the camera on her watch was more than up to the task.

parts.title: Mission Complete
parts.text: Agent Luna escaped just as the sun rose. The documents revealed a network of stolen art worth millions. Liam met her at the safe house, and his usually rapid speech slowed to something almost gentle. "Outstanding work," he said. "You've just solved a case that's been open for fifteen years." Luna allowed herself a small smile. Another mission complete — but she knew the next one was already waiting.

secretPassage.instructions: Read the passage below. Fill in each blank with the correct vocabulary word from the word bank.
secretPassage.passage: Agent Luna tracked a stolen painting to a _(1)_ old workshop — a dirty place with walls black with soot and grease. She crossed a _(2)_ in the path — a rounded rise in the ground — and crouched behind a wall. She used a small electronic _(3)_ — a gadget no bigger than her thumb — to scan for hidden cameras. Safe hiding spots were _(4)_ in the yard — there were hardly any — so she moved quietly and left no trace behind. She needed to _(5)_ her cover story first, setting it up before anyone could question her. The village had used a community _(6)_ — money saved together by the residents — to build a gallery that housed local art. Luna's _(7)_ was calm and confident, showing nothing of the danger she felt inside. The vault had _(8)_ room for every stolen frame — more than enough space, with shelves to spare. A single wrong step could send a _(9)_ across the still water in the courtyard, alerting the guards. She would _(10)_ stealth over speed, choosing silence rather than rushing. She made a _(11)_ move — brave and daring — and opened the vault door without a sound. The _(12)_ pace of her heartbeat slowed as the painting came into view, exactly where the tip-off said it would be.
